scene_description: A woman wearing an apron is standing at a stove in a kitchen, stirring food in a dark pan with a spoon. Steam is rising from the pan. Behind her is a basket filled with vegetables and other fresh foods on the counter. Kitchen utensils hang on the wall in the background.
